newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes plans to lift truck production.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes plans to lift truck production.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz AG said it plans to increase truck production to over 400,000 units over a mid-term time horizon from 330,000 units in 1995, Chairman Helmut Werner said on Wednesday.
The car and truck maker, which was showing its new line of heavy trucks at the race track here, said it expected its new Actros model to add around 500 million marks to profits.
